svg.title: ForgeLoop architecture
svg.desc: A developer request reaches an AI coding host, which works through ForgeLoop entry points. The deterministic control plane takes each task through contract, routing, preflight, execution with evidence, and review with a diagnosis and correction loop. It records state in SQLite, consumes host-run checks, and treats Jev as advisory. Completed tasks produce evidence bundles with an in-toto statement, optional Sigstore signatures and evidence-verify checks in CI and a GitHub App. The optional ForgeLoop Cloud adds encrypted sync, evidence publishing and a team dashboard.
svg.text: Verifiable engineering protocol for AI coding environments
Writes the code and runs tools;
reaches ForgeLoop by CLI, MCP or API
Owns lifecycle, claims, gates, evidence binding and completion
selected by routing for each task
ForgeLoop owns lifecycle, gates, evidence and completion.
The host implements the code; ForgeLoop never does.
Jev and advisory context never hold lifecycle authority.
